contradictions_and_confounders: The broad pre-schema dependency repaired the raw incident, but all rebuilt scoped raw variants, including all INT4 calls, did not.
Compiled layer0 and all-INT4 dependencies repaired the focused incident while the compiled Python model event did not.
The focused wrong token had only a 0.015625 packed top1/top2 score margin, making token identity sensitive to small ordering or code-generation changes.
Cold and trace-heavy 5-12 tok/s diagnostics are not comparable to warmed throughput.
The final four-prompt pass did not generalize: the matched final-source candidate was only 15/25 exact at 96.386 tok/s.
Broadening the sole correction to all INT4 calls worsened parity to 12/25 and remained below 100 tok/s.
The final-source target differs from the older target on 10/25 prompts, so only the newly matched target is a valid comparator.
